title.quote: Peer-to-Peer Energy Trading and Energy Conversion in Interconnected Multi-Energy Microgrids Using Multi-Agent Deep Reinforcement Learning

analysis.description: The paper investigates solutions for peer-to-peer energy trading and internal energy conversion within interconnected multi-energy microgrids (MEMGs) using a multi-agent deep reinforcement learning approach. It seeks to efficiently manage energy conversion and trading to minimize costs and environmental impact while handling high-dimensional continuous action spaces in the context of MEMGs.

type.justification: The paper provides simulation results based on real-world datasets which demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach, indicating an empirical research type.
type.quote: Simulation results based on three real-world MG datasets show that the proposed approach significantly reduces each MG’s average hourly operation cost.
